# **GST Guide for a D2C Brand: Marketplace Gst, Tcs And Interstate Invoicing**


Direct to consumer D2C brands sales products directly to customers through their website social commerce channels and online market places this model allows business is to have control over their customer relationship however it also bring GST responsibility this is specially true when selling through channels are shipping orders across state border understanding GST for direct to the consumer brands goes beyond calculating tax on product sales businesses has to think about GST registration requirements they also need to consider tax collection as source on market place transactions there are rules for involving returns from customers and marketplace settlement existment also play a role all of these areas can impact how sales are recorded and reconcile a structured approached helps direct to consumer businesses keep invoices it also helps them tell the difference between marketplace deduction and GST liabilities organising records makes it easier for GST return feeling these guide cover the GST consideration for marketplace sales it also covers TCS and interstate invoicing the goal is to help growing online brands handle their compliance responsibility with confidence.


## Understand GST Registration Requirements for D2C Brands


Direct to consumer D2C brands sell their product to customer using their own website social commerce channels or online marketplace before a brand starts to sell a brand most find out is GST registration duties by looking at the branch on rover and the brand products category the branch channels and any applicable exemptions a brand that cells on its own website usually does not need the same market place TCS setup that a brand using a third party E-Commerce operator has CBIC say that section 52 TCS is relevant for supplies that a brand makes through an E-Commerce operator when the operator collect the payment for marketplace sales the branch registration rules can be different from the different rules that a brand has when it sells through its own channel some small suppliers of good flat are eligible may get an exemption from mandatory registration when a brand cells through and eCommerce operator but only if the brand follow specific conditions such as on interested supplies and enrollment rules D2C branch should check their eligibility carefully before trusting any threshold exemption especially if a brand sale is across state borders are uses serval platform.


For more details check out[CBIC GST registration rule](https://cbic-gst.gov.in/)


## Understand Marketplace GST and TCS


When are D2C brand sales through a marketplace it must keep the difference between GST that is charged on the product sales and tax collected at source TCS that ecommerce operator takes GST is applied to the supply based on the correct rate and the details of transactions TCS however is taken by the marketplace on qualifying taxable supplies when it collect the payment the market place deposit this amount under the GST rules and the supplier can match that reported amount using the GSS system for example for registered brand cells goods on a marketplace the platform settlement might for subtract its fees and TCS before sending the rest to the brand the brand must not simply see those reduction as a sale price it must handle sales and fees or returns and text items on separate lines market please settlement TCS records and sales invoices should be checked top 10 against the platform report and GST returns this practice stop the revenue shown in the books from drifting from what is reported to the GST system


For more details check out[GST portal return filling guidance](https://www.dmifinance.in/gst/gst-return-filing-process/)


## Create Accurate GST Invoices for Interstate Sales


Interstate invoicing matters a lot for D2C brand that sells to customers across India states for goods a transaction is usually called inter state when the sellers location and the place where the goods are delivered our union territories accept the special rule says otherwise IGST is the tax that usually comes on interstate supplies CGST or UTGST that usually come on interstate supply. Before you create an invoice double check this details the seller names the sellers address and the cells GSTIN if the seller has one write down the invoice number and the date record the customer names at the delivery address included description of each product the HSN code that taxable value and GST rate that applies not the place of supply and the correct tax type add any discounts are shipping charges and other adjustment that belong on the invoice for example if a D2C brand that is registered in Maharashtra cells good to a custom and Karnataka that interested in voicing will normally a IGST to the invoice because that sale is interstate if the same brand sell to a custom house also in Maharashtra that involving will normally add CGST and SGST instead because that sales is intra-state.

## **Conclusion**


A practical GST process helps D2C direct to consumer brands handle marketplace sales TCS deduction and interstate invoicing with confidence the main thing is to know the registration rules that applied tell the difference between GST and marketplace TCS create invoices and check settlements and returns obtain by keeping records and order and using the building software brands can cut down on mistakes and get better view of the sales and tax duties since GST rules changed base on the way the business is set up and the details of each transaction brands needs to check the duties against the latest official information or talk to an tax expert


## **Frequently Asked Question (FAQs)**


### **1. Does a D2C brand need GST registration ?**


It depends on turnover the nature of goods or services sales channels and applicable registration exemptions


### **2. What is TCS on marketplace sales?**


TCS is a tax collected by an eligible eCommerce operator on qualifying net taxable supply where it collects the consideration as prescribed under GST law.


### **3. Is GST on marketplace sales different from GST on website sales ?**


The applicable GST treatment depends on the supply and the transaction details marketplace sales may also involve TCS and platform settlement deduction


### **4. Which GST applies to interstate sales ?**


IGST generally applies to a taxable interstate supplies while CGST and SGST or UTGST generally applied to a taxable supply


### **5. How can Billing software help the D2C brand?**


It can help generate invoices, record returns, organize text details, track transactions and reconcile marketplace settlements.
